migrationNote: Format 2 splits each platform claim into independent wire and ui columns so the ledger can no longer present wire coverage as UI parity. Migrated from format 1 (2026-09-18, V5 plan item 5.4): every format-1 claim became the wire claim unchanged, and the ui column was seeded by mirroring it, with the UI-surface subset of the evidence as ui evidence (falling back to the full list for protocol-plumbing entries that have no distinct UI file). ui dispositions: implemented = reachable from a user-visible native surface; partial = reachable in part, with a mandatory reason note; planned = wire present, no UI surface yet; desktop-only and unsupported-by-wire mirror the wire claim. The ui column is now maintained separately from wire: flipping one must not flip the other. E.1 re-derivation (2026-09-20, V6): ui implemented additionally requires independent device evidence — a screen-registry entry or a checked-in device test; a note is commentary and grants nothing. Every ui claim failing that rule was honestly downgraded to partial with the evidence gap in its note.
